caption: The drawing depicts a single green chaise lounge, positioned horizontally and centered within a rectangular outline on a beige background. The chaise features ornate, rolled armrests at both ends—one higher than the other—each decorated with circular, floral designs. The seat, backrest, and armrests are upholstered in dark green fabric, bordered by intricate gold patterns. The base and legs are elaborate, with gold detailing enhancing the carved wooden structure. The legs have curved, claw-like feet, and the decorative gold accents are repeated along the frame and at key structural points. There are no additional objects or background elements present in the drawing.
title: Sofa
